notes.title: Look what we pulled out of the hat!
notes.content: [h3][i]Classic charm meets modern magic in the long-awaited prequel to one of the most iconic adventure games of all time.[/i][/h3][p][/p][p][b]ININ[/b] and [b]Smallthing Studios[/b] are proud to announce the upcoming release of [i][b]Simon the Sorcerer Origins[/b][/i] on October 28th![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="J28oQ1C9rGY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]With over three decades having passed since [i]Simon the Sorcerer[/i] first cast his spell on adventure game fans in 1993, [i][b]Simon the Sorcerer Origins[/b][/i] invites players to step back into the enchanting world of magic, sarcasm, and mystery – this time, to discover how it all began. [/p][p]Longtime fans will be thrilled to know that [b]the original voice actors return in both English (Chris Barrie) and German (Erik Borner)[/b], adding an extra layer of authenticity and nostalgia to this lovingly crafted origin story.[/p][p]The game features an [b]original soundtrack composed by Mason Fischer[/b], capturing the emotional range and whimsical tone of Simon’s magical world. And as a very special surprise, [i][b]Simon the Sorcerer Origins[/b][/i] includes [b]music icon Rick Astley[/b] in a special role, bringing a touch of 80s soul to the fantasy adventure.[/p][p]This prequel to one of the most beloved point-and-click legends will launch on [b]October 28, 2025[/b], and be available worldwide on all major platforms: Steam (PC, Mac, and Linux) with full Steam Deck compatibility, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series S/X.[/p][p][i][b]Simon the Sorcerer Origins[/b][/i] brings the charming style of the ’90s into the modern era: hand-drawn graphics, clever puzzles, humorous and emotional storytelling – and of course, plenty of Simon’s trademark sarcasm.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]And for fans of physical games:[/u][/b][/p][p]Standard retail editions for Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5, as well as a [b]Limited Special Edition[/b] for PC (Steam Key in Box), Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5 are now available for pre-order exclusively at [url="http://iningames.com"][u]ININGAMES.COM[/u][/url]![/p][p]But even if you aren't interested in a box filled with Simon the Sorcerer goodies, go check it out anyway for some exclusive wallpapers and a sample of the original soundtrack, downloadable for free now![/p]
